title: Choir and Hollow
author: Odile Almeida
blurb: Wendell Marchetti, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
